args.effects: Provide an actionable interface for evidence-producing food assessment if supported, with clear limits on inference; otherwise identify the missing measurement capability. This request itself performs no assessment and grants no safety, mastery or wellbeing.

Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.

Its smallest executable precursor must truthfully determine measurement availability and expose unmet requirements, without treating that check as an assay or permanently rejecting the missing measurement mechanism.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: Assess food composition, parameterized by inputStackId, quantity in supported inventory increments, requested endpoints (nutrition, specified toxicant, or both), and optional methodId, apparatusIds and consumableStackIds; modes check, measure, resume and cancel. It applies to any applicable actor and owned food, not just hazelnut. For this request the exact sample reference is item-62-lin-314, currently 0.9 unit. Do not infer any nutrition or toxicity value from its resource label, ownership, freshness, the earlier press result held=true/flexibility=0, or another resource's known values.\\nSmallest executable release: a coded method-availability check against implemented measurement contracts. Validate ownership, current quantity and access without reading hidden nutrition/toxicity fields. Report each requested endpoint as measurable, missing prerequisites, unsupported, or not assessed, with exact method/version and missing apparatus/consumable references when actually defined. Current evidence establishes no applicable assay or available apparatus; report nutrition and toxicity unmeasured, safety unknown. Do not invent a required instrument or chemistry from this absence. Route the missing measurement model into the same development handoff: implement the smallest physically grounded non-ingestive measurement supported by implementation facts, if one can be justified. An unavailable method remains explicitly pending, not a permanent prohibition. The current precursor must not advertise an operational assay.\\nCheck costs: one completed world round and 0.2 energy, no sample consumption, no apparatus, no reservations; disclose before execution. Development/review waiting and learning registration do not execute this check or advance the world. No work has occurred from this request. Checking method availability alone produces an availability report, not sample evidence.\\nA measure mode may execute only after a reviewed method contract supplies its actual observable mechanism, applicability, analyte scope, calibration/control requirements, detection limits, uncertainty, material disposition, integer work duration and per-step energy costs. These are not known here and must not be fabricated or defaulted to free measurement. Before confirmation, disclose those exact costs, sample consumption, required apparatus and consumables, risks and inference limits. Reject unavailable measurement execution without cost or sample mutation. No ingestion or automatic recruitment of participants. Any participant communicates and acts independently.\\nReuse existing inventory validation, work scheduling, evidence storage and rendering code where suitable; record exact reused handlers/revisions in the implementation manifest instead of claiming reinvention. Revalidate quantity, ownership and accessibility at execution. A real assay must debit or reserve only its declared inputs, record stepwise work and costs, conserve remaining sample plus consumed/transformed material and accounted waste, and produce only its declared actual outputs. No duplicate sample, replacement stock or hidden-property lookup. Persist completed steps and paid costs; interruptions pause resumable assay work only where its method permits, otherwise mark it interrupted and invalidate compromised results.
